subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo / rotating time slots
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khanna <samir.khanna@oceanichealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo / rotating time slots

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to hear more about Oceanic Health's ingestion patterns and the volume spikes you see during payroll and reporting windows. Quick recap from our side:

- Key goals: reduce inference cost for peak windows, improve 95th percentile latency for patient-facing features, and maintain strict auditability for PHI-sensitive flows.
- Current constraints: mixed on-prem/cloud infra, regional data residency for EU and APAC, and unpredictable weekly burst traffic.

Next steps we discussed:
1) 60-minute technical demo + walk through architecture options (including Private VPC and Dedicated pools)
2) A short ops Q&A with your infra lead (Jing Wei) to validate network/KMS needs
3) Propose a rotating demo schedule so we can include stakeholders across US/EU/APAC without forcing late nights.

For scheduling: if you can share 2-3 preferred times across your team, we can propose a rotating set of slots that repeats weekly. Below is my availability next week as a starting point (all times in local TZ shown):
- Tue 30 Mar, 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET
- Wed 31 Mar, 16:00 CET / 23:00 SGT
- Thu 1 Apr, 08:00 PT / 17:00 CET

I attached a short demo agenda and a .ics for rotating slots to make it easier to add to calendars.

If Jing or anyone else prefers, we can propose a rotation like: Week A (US-friendly), Week B (EU-friendly), Week C (APAC-friendly) — more below in the proposed schedule.

Thanks — happy to coordinate.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0137

Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo / rotating time slots

Hi Camila,

Appreciate the recap — that aligns well with what we discussed. Jing (cc'd) is our infra lead based in Singapore and will need to be on the ops Q&A. A couple quick things from our side:

- Prefer the demo to be no more than 60 mins with 15-20 mins of infra Q&A.
- We have stakeholders in SF (product), London (security), and Singapore (infra) — rotating slots would be ideal.
- Our typical availability next week: Mon/Tue afternoons UK time, Wed mornings SF time, Thu/ Fri flexible for APAC.

Can you propose a concrete rotation? Also confirm whether we should loop in procurement ahead of the demo (procurement prefers to see a draft SOW before the technical deep dive).

Thanks,
Samir
VP Product, Oceanic Health
samir.khanna@oceanichealth.com | +44 20 7946 0123

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khanna <samir.khanna@oceanichealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jing Wei <jing.wei@medsys.cn>
Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo / rotating time slots

Hi Samir — thanks, and welcome Jing.

Below is a concrete rotation proposal that keeps the demo to 60 minutes (40m demo / 20m Q&A) and rotates the meeting window weekly so each region gets a friendly time every third week. Time conversions included for clarity. All times are proposed in local times for the region in parentheses.

Rotation proposal (weekly repeating):
- Week A — US-friendly slot
  - Wed 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET (US attendees) — 60 minutes
  - Equivalent: Thu 18:00 CET / Fri 01:00 SGT (less ideal for APAC)

- Week B — EU-friendly slot
  - Tue 16:00 CET / 11:00 ET / 08:00 PT — 60 minutes
  - Equivalent: Wed 23:00 SGT (APAC can join recorded ops Q&A)

- Week C — APAC-friendly slot
  - Thu 09:30 SGT / 02:30 CET / Wed 17:30 PT — 60 minutes
  - Equivalent: Thu 10:30 JST

Notes and options:
- If your security/product folks in London prefer, we can shift Week B from 16:00 CET to 15:00 CET to make it slightly better for APAC (moves SGT to 22:00).
- We can include a 15-minute pre-call for infra leads (Jing + our infra PM) on the APAC-friendly week to avoid late-night overlap.
- I'll attach the demo agenda and a single .ics that contains the three rotating slots — you can import to your calendar and remove the weeks that don't apply.

Next steps:
1) Confirm preferred start week (we can begin as early as next week).
2) Tell me whether procurement should join the demo or you'd rather we share a draft SOW ahead of time — we can do either.
3) If the rotation looks good, I'll send a Calendly poll (or direct .ics invites) for the first three instances so stakeholders can accept the one that works.

Thanks again — happy to set the first session for Week A next Wednesday 09:00 PT if that works for your SF team.

Best,
Camila
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Samir — Marissa here (solutions engineer). Camila put together a great plan. A couple quick practical items from the delivery side:

- We can run the demo from either Dedicated or Private infra depending on what you want to validate — we'll bring both configs.
- Procurement: we typically share a short SOW + proposed T&Cs after the tech demo; if you want procurement on the call, we can invite them to the EU-friendly session (Week B).

Camila — I created a Calendly poll with the three slot types and linked the HubSpot opportunity for reference: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/30min?cid=oh-1234 (same as the link in metadata). If Samir confirms start week = next week, I'll send the first three invites and include a 15-min infra pre-call on the APAC week.

Samir / Jing — does Week A starting Wed 07 Apr 2027 09:00 PT work for you? If so, I'll lock and send invites.

Thanks,
